title: No registration, no plates: A look into the rising 'sovereign citizens movement'
summary: Local news profile of a right-to-travel YouTuber who sells 'private, not for commerce' plates, has been jailed, and is part of a movement estimated in the hundreds of thousands.

assertions.quote: SOME ESTIMATES PUT NUMBERS AT SEVERAL HUNDRED THOUSAND TO HALF A MILLION PEOPLE.

verdicts.note: SPLC estimates around 300,000, but there is no membership and figures are rough guesses.
SPLC estimated 100,000 hard-core and 200,000 testing believers in 2010, and reports in 2022 put it at up to 500,000; the authors call the methodology questionable.
Best available estimates (SPLC) put US sovereign citizens at about 300,000-500,000, though the review stresses accurate prevalence is hard to establish.
Review cites rough estimates of about 300,000 US members and supporters, while stressing counting is difficult due to overlap and lack of monitoring.

assertions.quote: HE MAKES MONEY BY SELLING LICENSE PLATES AND WORKS AS A REVEREND.
HE HAS BEEN ARRESTED AND HAS SERVED TIME IN JAIL.
